package.name: S8Edge
package.shortDescription: Brings Galaxy S8 Infinity to iOS (rootless, iOS 15+)

descriptionlist.description: Adds a passive system-wide overlay with customizable rounded screen corners and subtle Infinity-style edge glow on the left and right edges.
Modernized for iOS 15-16+ rootless jailbreaks (Dopamine & Palera1n) with SBWindowScene attachment so the overlay displays reliably on iOS 16+.
Uses a lightweight touch-passthrough window (_ignoresHitTest) that never steals keyboard focus or blocks gestures.

changelog.change: Fixed iOS 16+ display by attaching the overlay window to SpringBoard's SBWindowScene
Configurable corner radius, corner color (black/white), and edge glow opacity in Settings
